# Blueberry Tea-Cakes

## Ingredients

- 2 cupfuls flour
- pinch of salt
- 2 teaspoonfuls baking-powder
- 1 tablespoonful butter
- 1 egg yolk
- 1/2 cupful sugar
- 1 cupful milk
- 1 egg white, stiffly beaten
- 1 heaping cupful blueberries, dredged with flour

## Instructions

1. Sift two cupfuls of flour with a pinch of salt and two teaspoonfuls of baking-powder.
2. Work into it a tablespoonful of butter.
3. Add the yolk of an egg beaten with half a cupful of sugar, and one cupful of milk.
4. Fold in the stiffly beaten white of the egg.
5. Add a heaping cupful of blueberries, which have been dredged with flour.
6. Bake for half an hour in muffin pans.

## Notes

Sour milk may be used with half a teaspoonful of soda instead of the baking-powder.
